description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [100% Critical (25s)] to the user, grants [Instant Cast 3], [Damage Cap +10000 3] and [Faithful Samurai Mode] to the user if 4+ FF6 allies are alive

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Faithful Samurai Mode
description.text: Casts Martial Strike three times after using a Fire ability, removed after triggering, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]
